notes.title: Sim Solver Known Issues
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Just wanted to let everyone know about a few issues that I've encountered while playing, none are game-breaking but wanted to make them known.

As this is my first game and mainly a way for me to learn Unreal Engine and kickoff my journey to making a career in the game industry, I can't guarantee fixes but please let me know of any issues and Il will do my best!

Thanks for playing and I hope you enjoy my first crack at a game!


The 4th level "Code Space Detour" has a major stutter on the initial load. 
-It lasts for about 20 seconds, if you stay still and let in work through the stuttering then everything should run as intended after that.  
-Looking into fixes

Minor pop in on level loads for certain levels with higher detail assets

Small items when picked up can get lost in level geometry
-When handling small objects like keys, be careful with your movement as to not glitch the game and lose the key.
-All inputs that require keys have multiple copies at key locations so if you lose one you can grab another.
